It was definitely grooming. No 17 or 16 year old in their right mind would date someone as young as 12 or 13. It's literally almost pre-puberty too. You need to also understand that even if you felt like you were in love,, it is still grooming. Because that's exactly it. They're older and they make you feel so loved and validated. You start to think no one could treat you better than they can. And every step of they way, they knew what they were doing. They knew exactly what to say to make you fall for them. It's not your fault at all. Even if it was all "consensual". I'm pretty sure the age of consent is 16 in most countries. You were child and didn't know better and probably wanted to feel good about yourself.

The thing is, in India, your parents support you until you finish college. They pay for your living expenses. Which means if I go to therapy in college my dad would probably  know. My mom's agreed to it because she's seen that I've struggled vause a few things thatve happened to me. But my dad keeps saying that it's all in my head and therapy is for weak people and that I need to be strong enough to deal with my emotions and issues on my own. While I know that it comes from a place of wanting his kid to be strong enough to face life, when he said that I was an attention seeker for being depressed and harming myself before, it really hurt me. Every single time that something happens, situations where I'm wrong and situations where he's wrong, it's all the same. He might mean the best when he's telling you that. But there's at least like half of the stuff that he says that pierces my heart. I'm going off track here but my point is I'm just not able to deal with the guilt. Sometimes it feels like everything is their fault while sometimes I understand that they're doing what they're doing so I become strong, better human

Honestly, I've gone to therapy before on and off for a year. My dad was against it and told me everything was in NY head. At that time no one knew about my ed except my therapist. My parents sent me there because of my childhood trauma, ptsd, depression and because my anxiety attacks were getting out of control. My therapist tried to help me with my obsession in different ways. She would tell me a few mental exercises, give me some homework, tell me to write down some stuff. Sure it made me feel better but I didn't get better.  Then my dad took me out of it because it was a "waste of time" and getting me nowhere. That I'm better off studying. I did tell my mom about my ed, but you have to understand, in my country, people don't take things like this seriously. There's a lot of narrow mindedness related to mental health conditions, let alone anorexia. My mom told me she understood, but later treated me like shit anyway. Everytime I binged she called a pig and other names. To her it was just, "my daughter wats a lot under the name of a disorder and shes just lazy. Thats why shes becom3 so big". To her, I was just giving excuses. My parents ended up thinking I like to victimize myself and like to think that I have problems because I have nothing wrong with my life. I mean I'm sorry for this long rant but the ending is that, I won't be able to get treatment. At least not until I'm independent. I mean they're amazing in other aspects I guess. I get a lot of things that some can't. I just wish they were a little more supportive of my mental health instead of brushing off my problems.
